_comment: Defensive performance budgets (ROADMAP heuristic A), measured in the IWER Quest 3 emulator on the production build with the CPU throttled. Exceeding any of them fails `npm run ci`.
_throttleRationale: i7-8750H (dev PC) and Snapdragon XR2 Gen 2 (Quest 3) score alike single-core (~1300-1400 Geekbench 6); 3x covers sustained thermal throttling, the XR2+ variant and browser overhead on the headset.
_frameRationale: The whole frame includes the framework (IWSDK input raycasts, uikit, three.js render). Reference = Meta's own IWSDK starter scene (published as Quest-ready), measured on 2026-10-03 under these exact conditions (prod build, IWER, 3x throttle): p50 18.8 ms, p95 29.4 ms, 72 draw calls, 81,688 triangles. Our scene must never be heavier than that reference.
